indie_brands.name: Holy Headen
indie_brands.notes: Mumbai-based homegrown streetwear brand. Visual art transformed into luxury apparel. Known for heavily embroidered jackets, boots, and statement pieces. 25,000+ orders shipped, 15+ artists styled.

indie_brands.name: Farak
indie_brands.notes: Jaipur-based, founded 2021. Urdu for 'difference'. Blends South Asian heritage craftsmanship (block printing, hand embroidery, weaving) with contemporary streetwear. Varsity jackets, bombers, hoodies. Cricket-meets-craft capsule collections.

indie_brands.name: Breakkin Even
indie_brands.notes: Experimental and made-to-order sustainable streetwear brand. Built on sustainability — garments made to order to reduce waste. Known for denim jorts, hoodies, and statement pieces. Small-batch, indie.

indie_brands.name: Hermyne
indie_brands.notes: Founded 2020, Surat. Reimagines saree and kurta fabrics into modern tops, shirts, and sets for fashion-forward gen. Website-only model (pulled from all e-commerce platforms). Kurta sets, anarkalis, farsi salwar suits, bralette tops.

indie_brands.name: Aiv Atelier
indie_brands.notes: Banarsi fusion brand. Featured in '5 Brands for Banarsi Fusion Outfits' content. Specialises in banarsi brocade fusion — predraped sarees, gowns, coord sets, off-shoulder silhouettes blending traditional Banarasi weaves with contemporary cuts.

indie_brands.name: Mahima Mahajan
indie_brands.notes: Delhi-based designer label. 848K+ Instagram followers. Luxury bridal and festive wear — lehengas, anarkalis, sharara sets, sarees, gowns. Hyderabad, Mumbai and Delhi stores. Ready-to-ship and made-to-order. Known for signature collections like Mehfil, Fanah, Mahiya.
